youtube_short.title: Your Loyalty Points Are Secretly Dying
title_alternatives: $512 in Points Expiring While You Sleep
The Loyalty Program Trap Nobody Talks About
youtube_short.description: Americans are sitting on $48 billion in unredeemed loyalty points — and the average household loses $512 to expiration every single year without realizing it. You're enrolled in nearly 15 programs but only actively use 7. Airlines delete your miles after 18 months of inactivity. Hotels wipe points in 12. And if you think your points are sitting there safely? Airline mile values have dropped 43% since 2015 — so they're losing purchasing power even before they expire. Go check every loyalty account you have this week. #loyaltypoints #personalfinance #moneytips #creditcardrewards #financetips
